title.narrative: Systems Approach for Ensuring Online Safety and Empowerment of Children and young People (SAFE Online)

description.narrative: The action aims to contribute to the empowerment and protection of children and young people against OSEC and online violence. The project will empower children and young people, particularly from vulnerable groups in Manila, Cavite and Leyte in the Philippines, to protect themselves, to become agents of change and to mobilize/ influence child protection system actors to uphold strong protective measures and responses.
